# Awesome Spinel

> {{ site.description }}

Spinel (https://github.com/matz/spinel) is Matz's ahead-of-time compiler for a subset of Ruby. This list collects projects that compile with it today: games and emulators, web frameworks and servers, command-line tools, gems ported to Spinel, developer tooling and experiments. It is maintained by its author, not by the Spinel maintainers.

## Docs

- [Full list as Markdown]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/llms-full.txt): every project with its link and a one-line description, grouped by section
- [Repository](https://github.com/aristotelesbr/awesome-spinel): source of the list; additions come as pull requests
- [How to add a project](https://github.com/aristotelesbr/awesome-spinel/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Optional

- [Spinel](https://github.com/matz/spinel): the compiler, its documentation and the spin package manager
- [spin-index](https://github.com/matz/spin-index): the package index spin resolves against
